test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_hull_state_transfer_{groups} (id UInt64, p Point) ENGINE = Memory
test.query: SELECT sum(length(hex(s))) FROM (SELECT groupConvexHullState(p) AS s FROM bench_hull_state_transfer_{groups} GROUP BY id) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

SELECT groupConvexHullMerge(CAST(unhex(encoded) AS AggregateFunction(groupConvexHull, Point))) FROM (SELECT hex(groupConvexHullState(p)) AS encoded FROM bench_hull_state_transfer_{groups} GROUP BY id) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
